## Apa itu Channel?

Channel adalah **pipa bertipe** yang menghubungkan goroutine. Goroutine bisa **mengirim** dan **menerima** nilai melalui channel. Ini adalah cara idiomatis Go untuk komunikasi antar goroutine.

> **Filosofi Go:** *"Do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating."*

## Membuat Unbuffered Channel

```go
ch := make(chan int)    // channel untuk int
ch := make(chan string) // channel untuk string
```

## Operasi Send & Receive

```go
ch <- 42      // KIRIM nilai 42 ke channel
val := <-ch   // TERIMA nilai dari channel
```

## Blocking Behavior

Unbuffered channel bersifat **synchronous**:
- **Send** akan memblokir sampai ada goroutine yang menerima
- **Receive** akan memblokir sampai ada goroutine yang mengirim

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func sum(a, b int, ch chan int) {
	result := a + b
	ch <- result // kirim hasil — blokir sampai main menerima
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int)

	go sum(3, 4, ch)  // jalankan di goroutine terpisah
	go sum(10, 20, ch) // jalankan goroutine kedua

	x, y := <-ch, <-ch // terima dua nilai (urutan tidak tentu)
	fmt.Println(x, y, x+y)
}
```

## Menutup Channel

Gunakan `close(ch)` untuk menutup channel. Receiver bisa mendeteksi channel yang sudah ditutup:

```go
func producer(ch chan<- int) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		ch <- i
	}
	close(ch) // sinyal bahwa tidak ada nilai lagi
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int)
	go producer(ch)

	for val := range ch { // loop sampai channel ditutup
		fmt.Println(val)
	}
}
```

## Directional Channels

Gunakan directional channels untuk membatasi operasi:
- `chan<- T` — hanya bisa mengirim
- `<-chan T` — hanya bisa menerima
content_en:
## What is a Channel?

A channel is a **typed pipe** that connects goroutines. Goroutines can **send** and **receive** values through channels. This is the idiomatic Go way to communicate between goroutines.

> **Go Philosophy:** *"Do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating."*

## Creating an Unbuffered Channel

```go
ch := make(chan int)    // channel for int
ch := make(chan string) // channel for string
```

## Send & Receive Operations

```go
ch <- 42      // SEND value 42 to channel
val := <-ch   // RECEIVE value from channel
```

## Blocking Behavior

Unbuffered channels are **synchronous**:
- **Send** blocks until another goroutine receives
- **Receive** blocks until another goroutine sends

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func sum(a, b int, ch chan int) {
	result := a + b
	ch <- result // send result — blocks until main receives
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int)

	go sum(3, 4, ch)   // run in a separate goroutine
	go sum(10, 20, ch)  // run a second goroutine

	x, y := <-ch, <-ch // receive two values (order may vary)
	fmt.Println(x, y, x+y)
}
```

## Closing a Channel

Use `close(ch)` to close a channel. Receivers can detect a closed channel:

```go
func producer(ch chan<- int) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		ch <- i
	}
	close(ch) // signal that no more values will come
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int)
	go producer(ch)

	for val := range ch { // loop until channel is closed
		fmt.Println(val)
	}
}
```

## Directional Channels

Use directional channels to restrict operations:
- `chan<- T` — send only
- `<-chan T` — receive only

The channel stores an unlimited queue

quiz.question_en: In the example with two `sum` goroutines and `x, y := <-ch, <-ch`, which guarantee is correct?
options_id: Urutan `x` dan `y` tidak tentu, tetapi `x+y` tetap 37
Program panic karena dua receive dalam satu baris
Hanya satu nilai yang pernah diterima dari channel
options_en: `x` is always 7 and `y` is always 30
The order of `x` and `y` is not deterministic, but `x+y` is still 37
The program panics because there are two receives on one line
Only one value is ever received from the channel

quiz.question_en: What happens if a goroutine executes `ch <- 42` on an unbuffered channel and no receiver is ready?
options_id: Nilai otomatis masuk ke queue internal
Goroutine memblokir sampai ada receiver yang siap
options_en: The value automatically goes into an internal queue
The goroutine blocks until a receiver is ready
The channel is automatically closed
The send silently fails

quiz.question_id: Jika goroutine mengeksekusi `val := <-ch` pada unbuffered channel tanpa ada sender yang siap, apa yang terjadi?
quiz.question_en: If a goroutine executes `val := <-ch` on an unbuffered channel with no sender ready, what happens?
options_id: Receive memblokir sampai ada goroutine yang mengirim
Receive mengembalikan zero value secara otomatis
options_en: The receive blocks until another goroutine sends
The receive automatically returns the zero value
The channel closes itself
The receiver becomes a sender

quiz.question_en: What is the purpose of `close(ch)` in the producer example?
options_id: Memberi sinyal bahwa tidak ada nilai lagi sehingga loop `range` bisa selesai
options_en: To free all channel memory immediately
To force all goroutines to stop
To signal that no more values will be sent so the `range` loop can finish
To convert the channel into a buffered channel

Runtime secara otomatis setelah satu receive

The sending or producer goroutine after it has sent all values

quiz.question_id: Apa yang harus benar agar `for v := range ch` berhenti secara normal?

options_id: Receiver harus memanggil `break` pada elemen terakhir
Channel harus ditutup setelah pengiriman selesai

The channel must be closed after sending is complete

options_id: Send memblokir tanpa receive pasangan sehingga terjadi deadlock
options_en: A syntax error
A type mismatch
The send blocks without a matching receive, causing deadlock
